visual.general_description: Three grayscale MR-type abdominal images labelled A to C: two axial slices and one coronal slice.

B (middle) is an axial slice at the level of the kidney regions with wide black side margins. C (right) is a coronal slice showing the spine and two large organs. panels.general_description: Grayscale axial abdominal MR-type image at the level of the upper abdomen with a bright oval fluid-like structure near the midline.
panels.detailed_description: An axial grayscale cross-section of the upper abdomen inside a black frame. A rounded body outline with a bright thin rim (subcutaneous fat or skin) surrounds the abdominal contents. The liver region lies at the left of the image as a mottled intermediate-signal area with a thin bright strip at its upper edge. A large homogeneous grey organ lies at the right of the image. Near the centre-left there is a bright oval signal-intense structure with small bright branching foci beside it. A round bright dot lies at the centre of the spine below. The letter "A" is printed below the panel. No arrows, annotations, scale bar or other text are printed.

panels.detailed_description: A coronal grayscale slice inside a black frame with a black margin at the right. Soft tissue of the flanks lies at both sides with brighter subcutaneous signal at the left and right edges. Two large rounded organs of homogeneous intermediate-low signal lie at the upper left and upper right of the image centre. The lumbar vertebral column runs down the centre with several disc spaces. A small bright oblong focus sits at the medial edge of the left-of-image organ. Mottled bowel-like signal lies below the organs in the lower half. The letter "C" is printed below the panel. No arrows, scale bar or other text are printed.
